heading: Import centre
description: Load many records at once from a CSV file: services and prices, drugs and consumables, lab tests or patients. Every row is checked before anything is written, and a batch is written whole or not at all.

new.heading: New import
new.noKinds: There is nothing you may import at this hospital.
new.fileHint: The first row names the columns. At most 20,000 rows and 5 MB. Save a spreadsheet as CSV (UTF-8).
new.mappingHint: For each field, choose the column of the file it is read from. Columns are matched by their titles where they can be.
new.patientsNotice: A file of patients holds patient data. It is read on this device and sent only to this hospital, and the rows are deleted once the batch is written or given up. Every patient written is recorded in the audit log.

values.amount: An amount in the hospital's currency, as 1250.50 or 1,250.50

file.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB. Split it into smaller files.
file.noRows: The file has a row of titles and nothing else.
file.tooMany: The file has more than 20,000 rows. Split it into smaller files.
file.longValue: A value in the file is longer than 2,000 characters.
file.unreadable: The file could not be read. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) and try again.
file.encoding: The file is not saved as UTF-8, so some letters would be damaged. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) and try again.

mapping.required: Choose the column this field is read from.
mapping.twice: This column is already chosen for another field.

batch.heading: Import of {{kind}}
batch.queued: Waiting for another import at this hospital to finish.
batch.staging: The rows were not all sent. Give this batch up and start again.
batch.checkedClean: Every row can be written. Nothing has been written yet.
batch.checkedProblems_one: {{count}} problem was found. Correct the file and import it again: nothing has been written.
batch.checkedProblems_other: {{count}} problems were found. Correct the file and import it again: nothing has been written.
batch.cancelled: This batch was given up. Nothing was written.

failures.stalled: Nothing was written: the work on this batch stopped without finishing. Import the file again.
failures.rows_refused: Nothing was written: these rows could not be written when it was tried, because the hospital's records changed since the check.
failures.permission_withdrawn: Nothing was written: the person who asked for it may no longer import these records.
failures.write_failed: Nothing was written: something went wrong while writing. Try again later.
failures.check_failed: The check could not be finished. Try again later.
failures.unknown_kind: Nothing was written: these records can no longer be imported.
failures.expired: This batch was left unfinished for a week and was given up. Nothing was written.

problems.not_allowed: Not one of the allowed values.
problems.too_many_decimals: More digits after the point than the currency has.
problems.invalid: Not a valid value: too long, too short or with a character that cannot be seen.
problems.not_found: Nothing of this hospital has this code.
problems.duplicate_in_file: The same record as an earlier row of the file.
problems.drug_exists: The hospital already has exactly this item.
problems.service_code_taken: The hospital already has a service with this code.
problems.lab_test_code_taken: The hospital already has a test with this code.
problems.patient_possible_duplicate: Someone like this is already registered. Check before importing them.

refusals.import_running: Another import is being written at this hospital. Write this one when it has finished.
refusals.import_not_ready: This batch cannot be written: it has not been checked, or it has problems.
refusals.import_busy: This batch is being checked or written, or is finished.
refusals.import_not_staging: This batch has already been sent for checking.
